node.title: L1 fixed-support cross-determinant fiber bound
node.statement: For one source chart, defect degree, and exact petal-support pattern, exact saturated monic pairs inject by Phi(F,W)=(W_0F-WF_0)/product_i L_(S_i) into polynomials of degree at most r_cross=2d+v-t ell. Hence their total number, across all missing-equation syndromes, is at most q^max(0,r_cross+1). Every fixed (p,r_cross) box is polynomial per source chart after summing all defect degrees. Thus a bounded-polarity per-chart counterfamily must have unbounded cross slack inside the proved survivor width window; non-intrinsic first-match chart supply remains separate.
